notes: DRAFT, DeadAsDisco.json's route with vars for the song row, arena and Infinite mode (ladders\DeadAsDisco.json). Mouse-driven menus, read from the desktop window (16:9 fullscreen on the Mopic monitor, captured at 1280x720; re-recorded 2026-10-08). Route: CONTINUE > stage hub > Enter > FREE PLAY > (arena) > (Infinite) > song row > click again to play > play_s of combat > Esc ends the song (RESULT) > Stage Select > Esc > EXIT GAME > EXIT GAME. Song list (8 rows visible, 48 px apart, row 1 at y 86; run discover n16.png): 1 Maniac (Radio Edit) - Hemlock 165, 2 Echolokators (Radio Edit) - Deckard Voltair 152, 3 Mission (Radio Edit) - Prophet 155, 4 Rhythm Divine (Radio Edit) - Arora 123, 5 Hyper Sunrise - Liquid Chroma 128, 6 Just Dance - Bad Computer 124, 7 Magazine (feat. RIENK) - Solomon France 168, 8 Remedy - Maliboux 128; songs 9-11 need the list scrolled (scroll -10 = to its end; then they should be rows 6-8 of 11, TODO). The install's free-play banks hold 4 more: Authority 165, Kitsune no Uta 174, Mensch Maschine 132, Neko Miku 194 (3 of them are songs 9-11). song_play_r<row> is the row's Play button (row 1's image at the row's y). Combat keys: LMB attack, RMB counter, Space dodge, E finisher, F takedown, T dance move, R drumstick toss, hold LShift fever rush, W/A/S/D move. Every played song posts a score to the brainCloud / Steam leaderboards of mopic.demo1 (global and friends), and Fans to the save. Never click GET THE GAME!, GIVE FEEDBACK, Playtest Signup, Report Bug, the social icons or Add My Music.

steps.note: with more than one save slot (Steam Cloud keeps a tutorial slot 2 from 2026-10-04) CONTINUE asks for a slot: slot 1 is mopic_demo1's progress

arena: the Arena Select tile (913, 225) opens a grid of the 8 arenas (Disco Floor 1 (295, 175), Disco Floor 2 (640, 175), Bubblepop 1 (985, 175), Bubblepop 2 (295, 360), Astral Waters 1 (640, 360), Astral Waters 2 (985, 360), Subcity Crypt (295, 545), Green Screen (640, 545)); a click moves the check mark there and the grid stays, Esc goes back. arena_open 0 keeps the saved arena. The choice is saved with the game.
Infinite (loop / survival) checkbox: infinite 1 clicks it once
scroll 0 for songs 1-8, -10 (to the end) for 9-11
the HUD pulses with the beat and loses hearts, so there is no stable gameplay checkpoint; the RESULT screen after Esc proves a song was played
